title: docmeta knowledge-graph frontmatter (1.0)
description: SKOS concept fields, PROV-O provenance, and iiRDS Core/Software typing under the top-level `kg` key — a docmeta-published revision of dockg's frontmatter-0.8 keeping every capability while adopting the house conventions: kebab-case keys, plain-language names, and single-value-or-list forgiveness on label fields. The `kg` envelope survives the house flattening rule deliberately: it is what lets a closed, typo-catching block coexist with an open page. Where the block and a page-level field speak to the same fact (`type`, `concepts`, `applies-to`, `revision-of`/`supersedes`, legacy `generatedBy`), the deeper declaration wins and the page-level field is the harvest fallback. The RDF term each field becomes is named in its description — which is where that mapping always lived, since half of 0.8's camelCase never mirrored upstream anyway (iiRDS spells its properties kebab: has-topic-type, relates-to-product-variant). Files without a `kg` key pass. AI provenance for the page itself lives at the top-level `generated-by` (docmeta:ai-context:1.0), not in this block.

label.description: The one canonical name of the concept this document is primarily about (skos:prefLabel). Renamed from 0.8's `prefLabel`; `alt-labels` carry every other name the concept goes by.

alt-labels.description: Alternative names — synonyms, abbreviations, spelling variants — for the primary concept (skos:altLabel). What search and retrieval match; `label` is what the graph displays.

related-concepts.description: Labels of associatively related concepts (skos:related) — a claim about the concept graph, independent of what this page covers. Named in step with the page-level `related-pages`: each says what it points at.

concepts.description: Concept labels this document is about (dcterms:subject, minting a skos:Concept per value). The deeper twin of the page-level `concepts`, same shape; when both are present this one wins. Renamed from 0.8's `subjects` — concepts are what these are.

type.description: iiRDS Core topic type (iirds:has-topic-type). The deeper twin of the page-level `type`: same name, and this closed iiRDS enum wins when present — the authority the no-invented-enums rule asks for. When absent, the deriver may default it from the page's type (how-to → task, tutorial → learning, explanation → concept).

applies-to.description: Product/variant labels this document applies to (iirds:relates-to-product-variant, minting iirds:ProductVariant nodes). The deeper twin of the page-level `applies-to`, same flat shape; when both are present, this one wins and the page-level field is the harvest fallback.

about-product-lifecycle.description: Which phases of the PRODUCT's lifecycle the content covers (iirds:relates-to-product-lifecycle-phase): a page about deploying or uninstalling the product. Renamed from 0.8's `softwareLifecyclePhase` so the about-ness is structural — this says what the page is about, never anything about the page's own `lifecycle`.

about-product-aspect.description: Which aspects of the product the content is about (iirds:has-subject, Software domain): its architecture, its interfaces, or its system requirements. Renamed from 0.8's `softwareSubject`, pairing with `about-product-lifecycle`.

not-applicable-to.description: Product/variant labels this document explicitly does NOT apply to (dockg:notApplicableToVariant). Disjointness from `applies-to` is checked at the graph layer (SHACL), not here.

not-about-product-aspect.description: Product aspects this document is explicitly NOT about (dockg:notSoftwareSubject). Disjoint from `about-product-aspect`, checked at the graph layer.

sections.description: Per-section iiRDS typing, keyed by GitHub-style heading slug. Keys are deliberately unconstrained here: a key matching no heading derives dockg:brokenSectionRef at build time, which is the right layer for that check.

revision-of.description: Repo-relative paths or URLs of earlier documents this one revises (prov:wasRevisionOf). The deeper counterpart of the page-level `supersedes`, which emits the same predicate as the harvest fallback.

derived-from.description: Repo-relative paths or URLs this document was derived from (prov:wasDerivedFrom). Lineage between documents — distinct from the page-level `source-of-truth`, which anchors the page to external reality.

provenance.description: Attribution for machine-proposed kg fields, one entry per model (consumers merge by generated-by; the schema dedupes identical entries); humans delete entries they have reviewed. Array only — 0.8's deprecated single-object form (the 0.2/0.3 shape) is dropped in this revision, which has no legacy documents to carry.

labelList.description: One non-empty label, or a non-empty unique list of them. The single-string shorthand is a widening over 0.8, which required arrays.

lifecyclePhaseList.description: One iiRDS Software-domain product lifecycle phase, or a unique list of them.

productAspectList.description: One iiRDS Software-domain aspect, or a unique list of them.

sectionMetadata.description: iiRDS typing for one heading section. Fields mirror the document-level kg fields; nothing is inherited from the document, and the SKOS hierarchy fields are deliberately not available per section.

type.description: iiRDS Core topic type for this section (iirds:has-topic-type).

applies-to.description: Product/variant labels this section applies to (iirds:relates-to-product-variant).

about-product-lifecycle.description: Product lifecycle phases this section covers.

about-product-aspect.description: Product aspects this section is about.

not-applicable-to.description: Product/variant labels this section explicitly does NOT apply to (dockg:notApplicableToVariant).

not-about-product-aspect.description: Product aspects this section is explicitly NOT about (dockg:notSoftwareSubject).

generated-by.description: Model that proposed the machine-filled kg fields. Kebab-cased from 0.8's `generatedBy`. This is fill's attribution trail for the block — the page's own AI provenance is the top-level `generated-by`.

fields.description: Which kg fields this model proposed. Self-referential and bounded — the twelve fillable fields, renamed with the schema. `sections`, `revision-of` and `derived-from` are deliberately absent, matching dockg's doc-level fill scope (section-level fill is deferred there, and lineage is not machine-proposed).

confidence.description: Per-field model confidence 0..1, keyed by the same fillable-field names as `fields` — a confidence attached to a typo'd or unknown field name fails here instead of dangling.
